# Third-party assets

This directory will identify the external implementations and pretrained weights used in the unified evaluation.

For each dependency, the release will record:

- project and official source URL;
- version, release, or commit identifier;
- checkpoint or weight identifier;
- original download location and expected local path;
- checksum when available;
- license or redistribution constraint;
- inference configuration used by the evaluation.

The list will cover GeoTransformer, RoMa v2, and the external baselines reported in the manuscript. Datasets and third-party weight binaries should be obtained from their original sources.
